title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-05
lineage: SBD MR > Cass >DAT > CD + AUD patch from low-gen cassette

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with variable clarity but an inspiring acoustic‑electric show highlighted by a stellar Know You Rider and powerful Black Peter
ai_review.review: The performance shines, especially the rare acoustic rendition of “Know You Rider” that many reviewers call the most spiritual they've heard, plus a haunting vocal on “Black Peter” and several electric gems. The soundboard source fluctuates – early sections suffer from audio‑patch glitches while the latter half sounds much clearer – but overall the show is regarded as a standout historical document.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (5 of 6) award four stars and praise multiple songs and the overall vibe; recording issues are noted but not enough to outweigh the strong musical performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality varies – some sections are clear, others suffer from “audio patches” and muddiness; later portions of the show sound notably better.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The acoustic set opens with a transcendent “Know You Rider,” then the electric material picks up steam; despite occasional patchy audio, the pacing and transitions keep the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice on Black Peter is highlighted as crystal‑clear and emotionally resonant.
